topic: Expert C++ Implementation Concept:  std::regex_match and its Compile-Time/Runtime Tradeoffs
explanation: This explores the implementation details of `std::regex_match` (and related functions like `std::regex_search`), focusing on the complex interplay between compile-time regex compilation and runtime matching.  We'll delve into how different regex implementations (e.g., using backtracking or deterministic finite automata) affect performance and memory usage, the compiler's role in generating optimized code based on the regex pattern, and the runtime behavior of the matching algorithm.
